First, could you please check your phone’s status bar and let me know if you see any of the following:
- Airplane mode icon
- Signal bars (even if empty or with an X)
- Any other icons related to network or data

If you’re able, please use your phone to check the status bar and describe what you see. This will help me identify the next steps to resolve your issue.
I now see 'Excellent' signal bars, 5G, and it says 'Connected to Chestnut-5G' in the status bar. Should I try using the internet or send a picture message to confirm everything is working?

Yes, please try using the internet (such as browsing a website or using an app that requires data) and send a picture message to confirm that both your mobile data and MMS are working correctly.

Let me know if both functions work as expected or if you encounter any issues.
I just tried both—my internet is working perfectly and my picture message went through right away. Everything looks good now, thanks!

I'm glad to hear that your service, internet, and picture messaging are all working perfectly now! If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a great day!
